'''January 2001 Liège tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Liège, Belgium on 7 January 2001. [[Koen Meijssen]] won it. It is known from Julien Riviere's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1604">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-08-liege-belgium-1-7-2001d1604/ liege-belgium-1-7-2001], DeckTech (Julien "Dark Padawan" Riviere, 8 January 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-08-liege-belgium-1-7-2001d1604/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 7 January 2001
* '''Site:''' Liège, Belgium
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
* '''Players:''' 41
* '''Winner:''' [[Koen Meijssen]]
